title: Esther 10
paragraphs: ¹ King Ahasuerus imposed a tribute on the land and on the coastlands of the sea. ² All his acts of power and might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, whom the king had honored — are they not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia? ³ Mordecai the Jew stood second only to King Ahasuerus himself. He was great among the Jews, held in high esteem by his many compatriots, for he worked for the good of his people and spoke up for the welfare of all his descendants.
